content.raw:
Endocrinology deals with the hormone-producing glands and the metabolic conditions they influence, such as diabetes, thyroid disorders and diseases of the pituitary and adrenal glands. Most of these conditions are diagnosed with blood tests and imaging and treated with medication and lifestyle measures, with long-term follow-up. MedLuxLife arranges a consultation with an endocrinologist at our partner hospital and coordinates any further tests or treatment.

For surgical treatment of the thyroid, parathyroid and adrenal glands, see Endocrine Surgery and the Thyroid and Parathyroid Clinic.

Treatments and services

Diabetes

Diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of type 1 and type 2 diabetes, including insulin therapy, modern oral and injectable medicines and screening for complications.

Thyroid disorders

Treatment of an underactive or overactive thyroid (hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism), Hashimoto's and Graves' disease, and assessment of thyroid nodules.

Pituitary diseases

Diagnosis and treatment of pituitary tumours and hormone imbalances, in cooperation with the pituitary clinic and neurosurgery.

Adrenal diseases

Assessment of adrenal gland disorders such as Cushing's syndrome, Addison's disease, hyperaldosteronism and adrenal masses.

Calcium, bone and parathyroid

Diagnosis and treatment of osteoporosis, vitamin D deficiency and parathyroid hormone disorders.

Obesity and metabolic syndrome

Medical assessment of weight-related metabolic problems, insulin resistance and metabolic syndrome, with referral to nutrition or obesity surgery where suitable.

Lipid disorders

Diagnosis and treatment of high cholesterol and triglyceride levels to reduce cardiovascular risk.

Reproductive hormones

Hormonal causes of irregular periods, hirsutism, PCOS, low testosterone and menopause-related complaints.

Tests and examinations

  • Hormone blood tests
  • Dynamic hormone stimulation and suppression tests
  • Oral glucose tolerance test and HbA1c
  • Thyroid ultrasound
  • Fine-needle aspiration biopsy of thyroid nodules
  • Bone density measurement (DEXA)
  • Imaging of the pituitary and adrenal glands in cooperation with radiology

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Recent hormone test results (for example thyroid tests, HbA1c)
  • Your current insulin or hormone doses

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Share your wishes and, if available, recent X-rays or photos. We answer your questions and explain the options.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

We coordinate your appointments, hotel and airport transfers, so you can focus on your treatment.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.

Plan your Endocrinology and Metabolic Diseases consultation with confidence

Every treatment begins with a personal, no-obligation consultation. Contact us and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Request a Free Consultation
